brief: Stop ignoring these 6 mistakes silently killing your product's conversion rate.

slots.body: Common errors silently destroying your product's conversion rate and revenue.

slots.title: Vague Value Proposition
slots.body: Users leave when they can't instantly understand what you offer and why it matters to them.
slots.calloutBody: Clarify your headline to communicate specific benefits within 3 seconds.

slots.title: Overly Complex Forms
slots.body: Every extra field reduces completions. Long forms create friction and drive potential customers away.
slots.calloutBody: Remove optional fields and enable autofill to streamline the user journey.

slots.title: Missing Social Proof
slots.body: Without reviews or testimonials, visitors trust you less and hesitate to make purchase decisions.
slots.calloutBody: Add testimonials near CTAs to build immediate trust and reduce anxiety.

slots.title: Slow Page Loading
slots.body: Each second of delay costs conversions. Impatient users abandon before your content even appears.
slots.calloutBody: Compress images and enable caching to keep load times under 2 seconds.

slots.title: Weak Generic CTAs
slots.body: Generic buttons like 'Submit' fail to inspire action. Your CTA must promise clear value.
slots.calloutBody: Use benefit-driven copy like 'Get My Free Guide' instead of vague labels.

slots.title: Broken Mobile Experience
slots.body: More than half of traffic is mobile. Clunky designs frustrate users and kill conversions fast.
slots.calloutBody: Test your entire funnel on mobile devices to ensure seamless touch interactions.

slots.body: Audit your product today. Small tweaks to these six areas can double your conversion rate.
